picks.title: 荒野丛林

picks.title: 故土
picks.summary: 改编灵感涉及托马斯·曼的真实经历及其传记素材。1949年，冷战正酣，诺贝尔文学奖得主托马斯·曼与女儿埃丽卡驱车穿越满目疮痍的德国，从美占区法兰克福前往苏占区魏玛。流亡美国16年后，曼重返故土，面对分裂的国家与破裂的家庭关系。
picks.summaryEn: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

picks.title: 多萝西
picks.summary: 在一个充斥着有毒男子气概的村庄里，勇于挑战世俗规范的多萝西到来，彻底颠覆了两位多年好友的世界观。

picks.title: 附带伤亡
picks.summary: 影片在夜晚的特拉维夫屋顶拍摄，揭示以色列在加沙对巴勒斯坦平民实施大规模杀戮背后的系统。
picks.summaryEn: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians

picks.title: 黑球
picks.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
picks.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

picks.title: 复仇者联盟5
picks.summary: 来自三个截然不同宇宙的传奇英雄们，将被推向一场生死对决，并最终直面一股前所未见、足以撼动万物存亡的终极威胁。
picks.summaryEn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
